cleanCheckoutNote: Fresh clones from GitHub with core.autocrlf=true. The full sequence ran on the first candidate ce8126f (same lockfile and runtime). Its verify failed on a test that matched multi-line source with LF endings (fixed in e97252d), and the visual suite found inactive tab panels no longer printing (fixed in 2fe1b0e). The same clones were then moved to the release commit 7b05a86 (certified source 2fe1b0e plus release metadata) and verify, build and ci-fast rerun there; the other steps depend only on the unchanged lockfile, runtime and seed.
